MRI RIGHT KNEE

INDICATION: Persistent right knee pain for several years, with seen in pt, had improvement, recent flare 1-2 weeks ago, no changes, no trauma, nothing seen on prior imaging

Routine MRI of the right knee shows no medial or lateral meniscal tear. ACL and PCL are intact. Extensor mechanism intact. Collateral ligaments intact.

No joint effusion. No Baker's cyst. No fluid collections. Full-thickness cartilage fissures are seen along the medial patella with significant underlying bone marrow edema measuring 15 mm transverse by 10 mm in depth by 10 mm in length, along the medial patella. No findings to suggest previous patellar dislocation, for clinical correlation. 

Edema is seen within the superior aspect of Hoffa's fat pad, just inferior to the lateral patella. There is a 3 mm bright PD focus just inferior to the patella which may represent a small focus of fat or bony fragment. TT TG is normal.

IMPRESSION:

No internal derangement.

Severe chondromalacia patella with cartilage fissures and intense bony edema in the medial half of the patella.

Edema in the superior aspect of Hoffa's fat pad, inferior to the lateral patella where there is a 3 mm globule of fat or possible bony fragment [could be evaluated by x-ray]. Findings suggest Hoffitis/fat pad impingement process.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif-orta derecede artmış. Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal eklemde en belirgin ve medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyinin posteriyor yarısındaki fokal tamkat, patella apeksi ve medyal patellar fasetteki kıkırdak kalınlığının %50'sin aşmayan kondral dejenerasyon, bilateral femoral tibyal eklem yüzeylerinde düzensizlik ve bunlara eşlik eden subkondral fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve milimetrik marjinal osteofiler ile karakterize. Tibya proksimal metafizinde lateraldeki intraoseöz kemik adası 8 mm çaplı. Distal femur metafizinin medyalindeki intraoseöz kemik adası 7 mm çaplı. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesindeki dejeneratif yapı içi intensite artışı serbest kenar düzensizliği-püsküllenmesi yanı sıra bazı düzeylerdeki lineer ılımlı hiperintensitelerin eklem yüzeyi-serbest kenara uzanması ile birlikte yırtık açısından şüpheli. Lateral menisküs normal. İç yan bağ ve çevresi hafif ödemli. Çapraz ve dış yan bağlar normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).

Normal menisci, cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus musculotendinous unit, extensor tendons, and the distal iliotibial band. 
A subcentimeter midline femoral trochlear osteochondral lesion with no evidence of instability is demonstrated. No other associated extensor mechanism abnormality.  No marrow signal abnormality of concern, the remaining tricompartmental articular cartilage is well maintained throughout. 
No intra-articular loose bodies. Minimal intra-articular fluid, probably within normal physiological limits. Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Regelrechte Artikulationsverhältnisse. Unverändert abgeflachter lateraler Tuberkel der Eminentia interkondylaris. Insgesamt geringe Gonarthrose mit konstant gering osteophytären Anbauten. Im Verlauf seit [DATE] progrediente, zur direkten VU [DATE] konstante zystische Knochenmarksläsion im Tibiaplateau mit zur VU etwas regredientem assoziierten Ödem mit Restbefund, DD belastungsbedingt, DD Ganglionzyste. Die vordokumentierten, vormals randständig synovialitisch KM-enhancenden zystoiden Läsionen ventral der Eminentia bzw. des VKBs zu [DATE] gering größenprogredient in den lateralen Anteilen, DD Ganglionzyste. Medial flächig geminderter Knorpelbesatz. Vordokumentiertes, fokal tiefgreifendes Chondropathie-Areal paramedian im lateralen Tibiaplateau mit assoziiert geringem subchondralen Ödem, dieses gering rückläufig. Innenmeniskus nach Teilresektion in Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn substanzgemindert ohne neue umschriebene Rissbildung. Außenmeniskus-Hinterhornwurzel zur VU konstant, im Verlauf zunehmend aufgefasert. LCL und MCL sowie die Kreuzbänder intakt.

Central supporting system  
 - Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Diffuse increased intrasubstantial signal of the almost entire ACL with only thin residual normally hyposignal fiber; intrasubstantial tear. No definite disruption or abnormal orientation is noted. 
 - Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Secondary buckling of the PCL is observed. No abnormal signal within the PCL is seen.  
 - Anterior tibial translation of 1.3 cm is noted. 
  
 Medial compartment  
 - Medial meniscus: Horizontal tear from the body to the posterior horn with minimal meniscal extrusion is observed. Ruffled inner edge of the meniscus without definite truncated contour is seen; meniscal flounce. 
 - Medial collateral ligament: Sprain of the superficial MCL is noted. The deep fibers of the MCL are preserved. 
 - Medial tibial plateau: Normal.  
 - Medial femoral condyle: Normal. 
  
 Lateral compartment  
 - Lateral meniscus: Normal. 
 - Iliotibial band: Normal.  
 - Lateral collateral ligament: Normal. 
 - Popliteus tendon: Normal.  
 - Popliteofibular ligament: Normal.  
 - Biceps femoris tendon : Preserved.  
 - Lateral tibial plateau: Normal.  
 - Lateral femoral condyle: Normal.  
  
 Patellofemoral compartment  
 - Quadriceps tendon: Normal.  
 - Patellar tendon: Normal.  
 - Medial patellar retinaculum: Normal.  
 - Lateral patellar retinaculum: Normal.  
  
 Others  
 - Physiologic effusion within the tibiofemoral joints and the patellofemoral joint is observed.  
 - Muscle bulks appear unremarkable. 
 - Neurovascular bundles are intact.   - Diffuse increased intrasubstantial signal of the almost entire ACL without definite disruption or abnormal orientation; intrasubstantial tear of the ACL. Associated with buckling of the PCL and anterior tibial translation of 1.3 cm. 
 - Horizontal tear from the body to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus with minimal meniscal extrusion. Ruffled inner edge of the meniscus; meniscal flounce. 
 - Sprain of the superficial MCL

Der Innenmeniskus in Pars intermedia substanzgemindert und im Hinterhorn deutlich signalalteriert (5/24 oder 6/5). Posterior des Hinterhorns gelegene maximal 7 mm messender parameniskale Zyste (7/12).

Kreuzbänder intakt. Unauffällige Darstellung des Kollateralbandapparates.

Findings:  There is a mild - moderate knee effusion. Normal appearances of the medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL. There is moderate diffuse thickening of the PCL, but no evidence of rupture. Moderate thickening of the cranial aspect of MCL is noted in keeping with a previous sprain. Normal LCL.  Mild lateral tibial cartilage edema is noted but no cartilage loss. Mild thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage is noted. There is moderate - severe thinning of the medial patellar facet and patellar ridge articular cartilage with mild underlying bony change. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Diffuse thickening of PCL. Is there a history of trauma? Old proximal MCL sprain also noted. Medial patellar articular cartilage degeneration noted. Mild - moderate medial compartment articular cartilage thinning.

An at least high-grade partial disruption of the proximal and midportions of the anterior cruciate ligament is noted, some fibers are apparently continuous. 
There is an associated significant joint effusion with suprapatellar extension. No intra-articular loose bodies. 

No associated osteochondral impaction injury, well-preserved posterior cruciate and both collateral ligaments, distal iliotibial band, both menisci, no posterolateral corner injury pattern is appreciated. No fracture or marrow infiltration. There is however an element of posterior capsular disruption as evidenced by the presence of ill-defined fluid in an extra-articular location at the level of the distal femoral supracondylar region. No associated anterior tibial translation. No other finding of note.
